w10_T4_004039: A beekeeper filled 149 frames of honeycomb, and each frame yielded 7 jars of honey. A neighbour gave her 7 more jars from his own hives. Over the winter market she sold 1046 jars, and 2 jars were broken in transit. In spring a cooperative delivered 79 unlabelled jars for her to finish. Half of her shed is given over to storage, and the cooperative records its stock in kilograms although the jars are labelled in grams. How many jars does the beekeeper have now?
w10_T4_004042: Ravi and Tomas keep sticker albums, and Tomas has always had fewer stickers than Ravi. Ravi bought 84 packets, and every packet held 4 stickers. His cousin sent him 31 stickers by post, and Tomas traded him 22 more. A shop assistant threw in 18 free stickers with his last purchase. Half of Ravi's album is still empty. How many stickers does Ravi have?
w10_T4_004043: Nadia and Peter grow chillies on neighbouring allotments, and Peter's plot always produces fewer than Nadia's. Nadia had 78 chilli plants and put in 8 more in April. Each plant gave her 8 chillies over the season. She handed 77 chillies to Peter, and 326 were sold at the allotment gate. One last chilli was carried off by a mouse, and Nadia's shed stands 12 metres from the gate. How many chillies does Nadia have left?
w10_T4_004044: On Thursday morning a stadium kiosk had 109 pretzels, and the baker delivered 35 more before the gates opened. At midday head office replaced the stock, sending 5 pretzels for every pretzel the kiosk was holding. During the afternoon a rival kiosk transferred 53 pretzels across. In the evening a late van brought 33 more. Half of the counter is taken up by the coffee machine, and 42 staff worked the match. How many pretzels does the kiosk have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004045: Grace and Dylan share a pottery studio, and Dylan throws fewer pieces each month than Grace does. Grace made 78 bowls in January and 76 more in February. For a gallery order she then produced 6 bowls in the style of every bowl she had already made. The kiln was too small for the whole batch, so the bowls were split evenly into 2 equal firings, and the first firing is the one being followed. Dylan added 7 bowls of his own to that firing, and the gallery afterwards bought 319 bowls out of it. How many bowls from that firing are left?
w10_T4_004060: A model club had 39 kits on its shelf. Members took 35 kits home over the winter and 1 kit was damaged beyond repair. The rest were shared equally between the club's 3 branches, and the town branch's share is the one to follow; the clubhouse has 18 display cases. The town branch built 5 models from each kit it received, and a supporter donated 63 finished models. The branch then sent an identical set of that whole collection to each of 6 libraries. How many models were sent out to the libraries altogether?
w10_T4_004062: Sofia and Ben run a bike-repair charity, and Ben logs fewer repairs than Sofia does. Sofia collected 104 old wheels, and a scrapyard matched her haul at a rate of 2 wheels for every one she had. She scrapped 131 wheels that were beyond saving, and Ben found 8 good ones in a skip. A sponsor then funded 4 new wheels for every wheel in the workshop. The wheels were finally shared equally among the charity's 4 drop-in centres, and the harbour centre's share went straight into storage. How many wheels went into storage at the harbour centre?
w10_T4_004066: On Friday morning a farm shop had 35 crates of eggs, and every crate held 6 trays. Before lunch a neighbouring farm delivered 70 more trays. In the afternoon the shop divided the trays equally between its 5 delivery rounds, and the village round is the one to follow. Early in the evening the driver picked up 18 extra trays from the dairy, and 4 trays were dropped and broken on a doorstep. The van has room for 300 trays. How many trays are on the village round now?
w10_T4_004072: A cafe had 23 bags of coffee beans in the storeroom. It used 11 bags during the week, and the roaster delivered 6 more. The manager split the bags equally between the 3 branches, and the station branch's share is the one to follow. The roaster then sent that branch 3 further bags for every bag it was holding. Each bag makes 9 flasks of filter coffee, and the station branch seats 48 customers. How many flasks of filter coffee can the station branch make?
w10_T4_004073: Early on Monday a workshop cut 114 planks, and each plank was sawn into 6 slats. Before lunch an apprentice found 4 spare slats under the bench. During the afternoon 622 slats were used up building fencing. In the evening the mill sent 9 replacement slats for every slat still lying in the workshop. Before the doors closed, 94 warped slats were thrown on the fire, and the workshop roof is 15 metres long. How many slats are in the workshop now?
w10_T4_004075: Yara and Tobias sell handmade candles, and Tobias makes fewer than Yara each season. Yara poured 228 candles in the autumn and 74 more before the fair, and each candle was packed with 6 tea lights of the same scent; the tea lights are what she counts from here on. The tea lights were divided equally between the 3 market towns on her route, and the Ashford box is the one to follow. Yara sold 349 tea lights out of the Ashford box, then had that exact box made up again for each of the 7 weekends of the Christmas market. How many tea lights did Yara use across those weekends?
w10_T4_004076: On Saturday morning Priya laid out 120 sheets of pressed flowers, while her friend Ade laid out fewer than she did. Before noon Priya's press split every sheet into 2 thinner sheets. In the early afternoon each sheet was cut into 6 cards, and later every card was scored into 3 bookmarks. Ade handed over 15 bookmarks of her own in the evening. Overnight the print shop produced 5 identical bookmarks for every bookmark on Priya's table. How many bookmarks does Priya have now?
w10_T4_004078: A scout group started its recycling drive with 158 sacks, and each sack was emptied into 4 bins of sorted cans. A local garage added 57 bins and the school added 30 more. The depot rejected 236 bins that were contaminated. A partner town then matched the group's stock exactly, so the group held 2 bins for every bin it had. A late donation brought 76 further bins. How many bins does the scout group have?
w10_T4_004081: On Tuesday morning Camille had 163 tulip bulbs, and her colleague Ben, who always grows fewer than she does, handed her 48 more. Before noon the wholesaler restocked her at a rate of 5 bulbs for every bulb she was holding. In the afternoon a garden club donated 37 bulbs. During the evening planting 144 bulbs went into the park beds. Just before dark Ben found 16 stray bulbs in his van and gave them to her. How many bulbs does Camille have now?
w10_T4_004094: A driving school had 169 lesson slots booked for the month, and 27 of them were cancelled by learners. Head office then ran the same timetable at each of its 7 branches, using that many slots per branch. A partner school transferred 50 slots into the same pool. The pool was shared equally between the 6 instructors, and one instructor's diary is the one being followed. Bad weather later wiped 70 slots from that diary. The school advertises lessons in hours although the diary itself is ruled in minutes. How many slots are left in that instructor's diary?
w10_T4_004098: On Wednesday morning a paper mill had 82 reels of card, and 58 reels were shipped out before lunch. Early in the afternoon each remaining reel was slit into 8 rolls. Later that afternoon every roll was cut into 9 sheets. In the evening a customer returned 58 unused sheets, which joined the pile. Overnight the mill's press printed 9 copies of every sheet in the pile. How many sheets are in the pile now?
w10_T4_004103: A village hall stored 93 folding chairs. A wedding party borrowed 25 of them, and the church took 63 more for its harvest supper. Woodworm ruined 3 of the chairs still standing in the hall. A closing-down sale at the school added 46 chairs, and a neighbour donated 22 more. Half of the hall is given over to badminton on Thursdays, and the caretaker records booking lengths in minutes although the parish notices give them in hours. How many chairs are in the village hall now?
w10_T4_004104: A ski hire shop opened on Saturday morning with 141 pairs of boots, and 100 pairs went out on the first lift. Before lunch another 35 pairs were hired. At midday 12 pairs came back from an early group. In the afternoon the supplier delivered 9 pairs for every pair still sitting in the shop. During the evening 52 pairs went out for the night slope. How many pairs of boots are in the shop now?
w10_T4_004106: On Sunday morning a soap workshop loaded 15 racks into the curing room, and each rack held 4 bars. By noon a second batch had doubled the number of bars in the room. In the afternoon a delivery of 54 wrapped bars joined them. In the evening the cutting machine produced 9 small bars out of every bar in the room. How many small bars are in the curing room now?
w10_T4_004110: A seed company started Monday morning with 147 pods, and a courier delivered 56 more before noon. At midday every pod was opened, and each one held 6 seeds. In the early afternoon a laboratory added 45 spare seeds to the tray. Later each seed was germinated into 6 seedlings, and by evening every seedling had been divided into 6 cuttings. Just before closing, 16 cuttings arrived from a partner nursery. How many cuttings does the company have?
w10_T4_004111: Hannah and Luis collect vinyl records, and Luis owns fewer than Hannah does. Hannah had 159 records and bought 71 at a car boot sale. Luis passed her 36 from his own shelves. She sold 192 records to a shop in town and lent 67 to her brother. Half of her living room wall is shelving, and the shop is 14 minutes away on foot. How many records does Hannah have at home now?
w10_T4_004113: A hospital pharmacy began the week with 145 boxes of dressings, and 59 boxes were sent up to the wards. A supplier delivered 68 boxes on Wednesday. The trust then stocked every department to the same level, providing 7 boxes for every box the pharmacy was holding. Over the following fortnight 312 boxes were used. A returned order put 51 boxes back on the shelf. Half of the storeroom is refrigerated, and the pharmacy logs delivery times in minutes although the rota is written in hours. How many boxes of dressings does the pharmacy have now?
w10_T4_004116: Aisha and Kwame run a printing co-op, and Kwame produces fewer posters than Aisha does. Aisha designed 226 artworks, and each artwork was printed as 3 posters. A damp store ruined 477 posters. A festival order then called for 9 copies of every poster still in the racks. Kwame added 14 posters of his own to the racks, and the festival collected 914 posters on opening day. The co-op measures its paper in metres although the rolls are sold in centimetres. How many posters are left in the racks?
w10_T4_004119: A dairy started Monday morning with 144 litres of cream, and the morning milking added 40 litres to the vat. Before noon 123 litres were churned into butter. In the early afternoon the dairy bought in 4 litres for every litre remaining in the vat. Later that afternoon a second purchase again brought in 4 litres for every litre in the vat. In the evening a partner farm matched the vat exactly, leaving 2 litres for every litre that had been there, and the dairy quotes delivery times in hours although the drivers record them in minutes. How many litres of cream are in the vat now?
w10_T4_004120: On Friday morning a climbing gym had 29 ropes in the store, and 3 of them failed inspection and were cut up. Before lunch a supplier delivered 41 ropes, and a closing gym donated 36 more in the early afternoon. In the evening the head coach ordered a full set for each of the chain's 8 branches, taking that many ropes for every branch. Overnight 224 ropes were sent away for testing. The gym posts session lengths in hours although bookings are made in minutes. How many ropes does the chain have now?
